keyPoints: Prithvi ke pare vishaal antariksh phaila hai — suraj, chandrama, taare, grah aur aakaashgangaen iska hissa hain, jinka koi ant nahi dikhta.
Suraj ek taara hai jo apni garmi aur roshni se poore saur mandal ko jeevan deta hai; uske bina dharti par jeevan sambhav nahi hota.
Budh, Shukra, Prithvi, Mangal, Brihaspati, Shani, Uranus aur Neptune — ye aath grah suraj ke chakkar lagate hain aur apni dhuri par bhi ghoomte hain.
Chandrama prithvi ka ekmatra prakritik upgrah hai; wo khud nahi chamakta, balki suraj ki roshni ko paravartit karke chamakta hua dikhta hai.
Raat ko taare timtimate dikhte hain kyunki wo bahut door hain; dhruv taara hamesha uttar disha me dikhta hai aur raasta batane me kaam aata hai.
Din-raat prithvi ke apni dhuri par ghumne (rotation) se hote hain, jabki dhuri ke jhukav ke kaaran saal bhar mausam badalte rehte hain.
Aam galti: suraj ko grah samajhna; suraj swayam prakashit taara hai, jabki grah suraj ke chakkar lagane wale aprakashit pind hain.
